Core: complete 10 practice sentences: five pronouns and five contractions
Extend: rewrite a repetitive paragraph using pronouns and contractions
Stretch: explain why we would not use contractions in a letter to a head teacher
questions.a: Contractions are informal; a head teacher letter should be formal
A) it's. it's means it is; the apostrophe replaces the i. its (no apostrophe) means belonging to it.
